title: Books with above-average length in their genre
statementMd:
List books longer than the average page count of their genre.

Expected columns: `title`, `genre`, `pages`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.title, b.genre, b.pages FROM books b WHERE b.pages > (SELECT AVG(b2.pages) FROM books b2 WHERE b2.genre = b.genre);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
